integrity: Self-contained general argument and reproducible finite test program. No external mathematical audit; literature novelty remains subject to undiscovered equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative local rings only; radical cube zero and radical square nonzero one-dimensional over residue field. For graph completeness (pairing rank one), graph parameters beyond ring cardinality are not reconstructed. Graph isomorphism is not ring isomorphism. Finite checks support but do not prove universal quantifiers.
title: Projective-clique structure of annihilator-inclusion graphs of short local rings
